subject.title: Feishu: replied/quoted message mentions show as raw @_user_N placeholders

question: Should maintainers adopt and narrow the open fork closing PR for this Feishu quoted-mention bug, or close that candidate and queue a fresh focused repair from current main?
rationale: The source-level defect and likely fix boundary are clear, but the issue already has a dirty open fork closing PR and a closed broad same-repo attempt, so duplicate automation should wait for maintainer ownership of that candidate path.

options.title: Adopt or narrow the fork PR
options.body: Bring only the Feishu fetched-message parser and focused tests from the fork lineage into a maintainable target-repo PR.

options.title: Queue a fresh focused repair
options.body: Close or ignore the fork lineage and let a repair worker implement the narrow parser/test fix from current main.

options.title: Keep owner-driven manual work
options.body: Leave the issue open for Feishu owners to design and prove the fix with live workspace evidence.

recommendation.title: Adopt or narrow the fork PR
recommendation.body: Bring only the Feishu fetched-message parser and focused tests from the fork lineage into a maintainable target-repo PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is inside the declared Feishu/Lark plugin ownership boundary.
